w:r.w:t: This service is part of RDS validation service to validation K12 applicant residency.
K12 application will provide the data of the household member and RDS validation service will validate with DOR and DOT and based on the rules defined will provide K12 a decision.
The process is asynchronous and normally would take 24-36 hours to send a response back since DOR and DOT process the files every 24
current RDS validation process has a
deadline for completion to account for any potential internal and external delays.

When the responses come back from DOR and DOT they are processed, and result will be pushed back to Azure Service Bus.
